title: AI Photo & Voice Learning Assistant

hardware.candidate: ESP-Mosaico ESP32-S31 Core Unit V1.2, LEFT H2 camera module (V1.4 SC101IOT candidate), onboard speaker/microphone

billOfMaterials.role: ESP32-S31 touchscreen core with dedicated left-slot camera; interaction module included

supplementaryRequirements: Cloud-region/model/account cost, privacy, child data and noncommercial firmware rights are distinct software release gates.

tests.name: Photograph Core PCB ID, camera module and ABI
tests.procedure: Read factory diagnostic/version screens without flashing
tests.acceptance: Core v1.2, camera model and recovery ABI logged

tests.name: Prove camera preview on factory-authorized compatible firmware
tests.acceptance: Correct orientation and stable image recorded

tests.name: Test Wi-Fi onboarding and signed-in cloud model in permitted environment
tests.procedure: Use personal test account, scrub all keys from evidence
tests.acceptance: Connection error/success logged without secret exposure

tests.name: Test recognition + spoken followup with synthetic worksheet
tests.procedure: Record transcript quality and response latency
tests.acceptance: Measured English behavior; do not assume translation shipped

tests.name: Review legal and data protections for commercialization
tests.procedure: Record license approval, data retention and student-data impact
tests.acceptance: No commercial deployment until software rights and privacy requirements satisfied
